Abstract
We present a novel framework for efficient sequence modeling. This work builds on prior approaches
by introducing a lightweight mechanism that reduces computational overhead while preserving
accuracy across a range of benchmark tasks. We evaluate the proposed method on three standard
datasets and compare against strong baselines from recent literature. Our analysis shows consistent
improvements, particularly in low-resource settings where prior methods tend to overfit. We further
examine failure cases to understand the boundary conditions under which the approach
underperforms.
